The measurement shows a significant drop in internal rotation to 15° with severe pain, while external rotation is limited to 45°. This "empty can" pattern often points to rotator cuff pathology, specifically involving the supraspinatus or infraspinatus. Can you tell me if you have noticed any weakness when lifting your arm against resistance, or if you feel a snapping sensation when moving your shoulder?
